stages.name: Scope analysis
stages.description: Find out with the user what the result must be and how to get there: goal, done criteria, constraints, interfaces, environment, non-goals, risks. Write PLAN.md, create most of the areas and topics, and one meta task per major deliverable. Ask the open questions. No implementation.

stages.name: Implementation
stages.description: Split the meta tasks into work tasks and implement them one by one: verify, report, done and commit with the user's permission.
